title: 主从延迟模拟与「读己之写」的破坏与修复（正反用例）
expected_output:
=== 主从延迟模拟与「读己之写」===
复制延迟 = 2 个操作（从库只可见 seq <= master_seq - 2）
写 5 次后: master_seq = 5, replica_applied = 3

场景1 写 profile:5 后立刻读从库
  从库读到 = None  => 读己之写被破坏 : True

场景2 修复A：写后读主库（会话标记 force_master）
  主库读到 = v5  => 读己之写被破坏 : False

场景3 修复B：客户端带版本号等待从库追上（required_seq = 5）
  等待 2 次重放后从库读到 = v5  => 读己之写被破坏 : False

对照：从库补齐到 seq = master_seq 后再读（延迟窗口已关闭）
  从库读到 = v5  => 读己之写被破坏 : False
  从库当前 replica_applied = 5, master_seq = 5

结论：异步复制下从库读到旧值是「正常现象」，不是数据丢失；
     一致性必须由会话层（写后读主 / 版本号等待）或半同步复制来保证。
code:
LAG = 2


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, lag):
        self.log = []
        self.master_seq = 0
        self.lag = lag
        self.replica_applied = 0

    def write(self, k, v):
        self.master_seq += 1
        self.log.append((self.master_seq, k, v))
        return self.master_seq

    def read_master(self, k):
        vis = {}
        for s, kk, vv in self.log:
            if s <= self.master_seq:
                vis[kk] = vv
        return vis.get(k)

    def read_replica(self, k):
        vis = {}
        for s, kk, vv in self.log:
            if s <= self.replica_applied:
                vis[kk] = vv
        return vis.get(k)

    def catch_up_step(self):
        if self.replica_applied < self.master_seq:
            self.replica_applied += 1
            return True
        return False


c = Cluster(LAG)
for i in range(1, 6):
    c.write("profile:%d" % i, "v%d" % i)
c.replica_applied = max(0, c.master_seq - LAG)

print("=== 主从延迟模拟与「读己之写」===")
print("复制延迟 = %d 个操作（从库只可见 seq <= master_seq - %d）" % (LAG, LAG))
print("写 5 次后: master_seq = %d, replica_applied = %d" % (c.master_seq, c.replica_applied))
print()

boundary = c.master_seq
v = c.read_replica("profile:5")
print("场景1 写 profile:5 后立刻读从库")
print("  从库读到 = %s  => 读己之写被破坏 : %s" % (v, v is None))
print()
v2 = c.read_master("profile:5")
print("场景2 修复A：写后读主库（会话标记 force_master）")
print("  主库读到 = %s  => 读己之写被破坏 : %s" % (v2, v2 is None))
print()
polls = 0
while c.replica_applied < boundary:
    c.catch_up_step()
    polls += 1
v3 = c.read_replica("profile:5")
print("场景3 修复B：客户端带版本号等待从库追上（required_seq = %d）" % boundary)
print("  等待 %d 次重放后从库读到 = %s  => 读己之写被破坏 : %s" % (polls, v3, v3 is None))
print()
v4 = c.read_replica("profile:5")
print("对照：从库补齐到 seq = master_seq 后再读（延迟窗口已关闭）")
print("  从库读到 = %s  => 读己之写被破坏 : %s" % (v4, v4 is None))
print("  从库当前 replica_applied = %d, master_seq = %d" % (c.replica_applied, c.master_seq))
print()
print("结论：异步复制下从库读到旧值是「正常现象」，不是数据丢失；")
print("     一致性必须由会话层（写后读主 / 版本号等待）或半同步复制来保证。")
